description: Land Title Settlement Department - Angalegedara, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510002 (23/0380)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
